correctness.rationale: For every m>=2 with positive generators a,b, normal form b a = a^{-1} b and b^2=a^m yields exact Parikh predicate: s=0 iff 2m|r; odd s rejected; positive s=0 mod4 iff r even; s=2 mod4 iff r>=m and r=m mod2. Each possible exponent r-2t is achievable when s>0; the four quotient classes are A-low (m-1), A-residue (2m), B-low (4m-4), B-high (4). The h(v) first-accepted-a-suffix witnesses distinguish them. Thus 7m-1 minimal DFA states versus 4m original group states. Independent product-count dynamic programming and independently formed bounded Myhill-Nerode signatures checked m=2..6; not a proof beyond bounds.
residual_risks: Finite numerical checks are only supplementary and do not establish the general theorem or bibliographic originality.
